title: Concurrent last-slot submissions can both be rolled back while consuming daily quota
evidence: After both calls pass a cap-1 precheck, both INSERT presets and append-only events. Each postcheck counts every event, observes cap+1, and deletes its own preset/votes, but not its event. No insertion-order tie-break on submissions although reserveDailyEvent uses one.
repro: At 9/10 events, synchronize two different valid palette requests so both recordSubmissionEvent calls complete before either postcheck. Both return 429; neither palette survives; effective count is 11 until midnight.
test_gap: tests/handlers/presets.test.ts:688 mocks one overshooting request and asserts preset/vote DELETE statements; no second request or surviving append-only event assertion.
fix: Reserve submission quota atomically or use the event's monotonic id as the final-slot tie-break and release reservations for rolled-back creates.
overlap: Related to 2026-10-26-security/FINDING-018 (pre-reservation Perspective work), but this candidate concerns false rejection and consumed quota.

title: Changing only the primary category can retain that category in secondary_categories
evidence: validateEditRequest receives only current primary; if PATCH has category_id but omits secondary_categories, undefined is passed to validator and accepted. updatePreset retains old secondary_categories.
repro: Existing primary=jobs, secondary=[zones]. PATCH only category_id=zones. Stored primary and secondary both contain zones.
test_gap: tests/handlers/presets.test.ts:2975 sends both lists; :3001 tests an explicitly repeated primary; :3059 tests supplied secondary against unchanged primary. No promotion with omitted secondary list.
fix: Validate effective primary plus effective secondary list after merging edits with the stored preset; optionally normalize away the promoted secondary.

title: New-preset response reports vote_count 0 after the author's auto-vote is committed
evidence: createPreset returns vote_count:0. The handler awaits addVote, which recomputes stored vote_count, then returns the original preset object rather than submittedRow or refreshed count.
repro: Submit a new approved preset; POST response preset.vote_count=0 while immediately reading that preset yields 1.
test_gap: tests/handlers/presets.test.ts:552 success case checks status, success, name and moderation_status at :606-610; no returned vote_count or DB-state comparison.
fix: Build the response from the post-vote row already read for notification or copy the successful vote result's count.

title: Concurrent preview replacements and preset deletion leave uploaded R2 objects orphaned
evidence: Upload reads previousKey before image work and overwrites the row unconditionally, deleting only that stale key. Two uploads starting from A store B/C and both delete A; whichever loses its row reference is never removed. UPDATE changes=0 after concurrent preset deletion is also treated as success.
repro: Synchronize two uploads after both read A; complete B then C. Row points at C, A deleted, B remains indefinitely with no DB reference. Or delete preset between read and UPDATE: upload returns success and stores an unreferenced image.
test_gap: tests/handlers/presets.test.ts:1865 uploads sequentially (:1895), missing overlapping old-key reads. presets-quotas.test.ts:1160 covers thrown UPDATE, not successful zero-change UPDATE. preview-revision.test.ts covers moderator key binding, not author upload/delete CAS.
fix: Compare-and-set against captured image state, inspect changes, remove newly stored object on lost/deleted row, and clean only the replaced key for the winning update.

title: Favorite list can exceed Discord's embed description limit for legal preset names
evidence: All 50 favorites are joined into one description with no total budget. Legal 50-character names can expand to 100 characters after markdown escaping; sanitizePresetName permits 100. HTTP rejection returns false and this adapter ignores it.
repro: Favorite 50 distinct legal presets whose 50-character names contain underscores. Sanitized names alone can exceed 4096 characters before numbering/categories; edit fails.
test_gap: preset.test.ts has no favorite-list cases. Add a 50-entry escaped-name case asserting <=4096 description and handling failed edit.
fix: Paginate or budget complete lines within 4096 including escaped names and truncation notice; check edit success.

title: Favorite listing still fans out up to 50 individual preset API reads
evidence: Promise.all calls getPreset once per favorite, each a separate signed service-binding request and row query. Oct4 OPT-003 remains OPEN and current implementation is unchanged.
repro: 50 favorites produce 50 getPreset/PRESETS_API.fetch calls; capped batch can reduce to one request/set query.
test_gap: Add 50-entry call-count benchmark after batch endpoint exists. No runtime benchmark performed.
fix: Deploy capped approved-only batch-by-id API first, then switch caller preserving order/missing IDs. Up to 49 fewer service-binding calls and row lookups.
overlap: Supersedes 2026-10-04-deep-dive/OPT-003 (OPEN). Same fan-out is security FINDING-024 because userless reads bypass limiters; schedule one fix.

title: Favorite list presents transient API failures as permanently removed presets
evidence: getPreset returns null for 404 and throws for 429/5xx/network errors; list catches all as null. All transient failures produce allRemoved; partial failures silently omit existing favorites and reduce displayed count.
repro: Nonempty favorites and PRESETS_API returns503 for everyGET. List sends allRemoved and no upstream outcome mark.
test_gap: preset.test.ts has no favorite-list cases. Add all503 and mixed found/404/503 outcomes.
fix: Preserve found/missing/failed outcomes; show and trace upstream failures; identify partial results.
overlap: Oct4 BUG-047 fixed autocomplete persistence; this separate list-response path still swallows transient errors, without writing KV.

title: Glamour adapter records failed Discord edits as successful commands
evidence: safeEditOriginalResponse catches HTTP/network errors, logs and returnsfalse. Glamour adapter awaits but ignores boolean, so no throw reaches catch/outcome handling. Trace with no mark defaultsok although deferred result was never delivered.
repro: Have editOriginalResponse return HTTP400/429/500 after successful generation. Adapter resolves; failed edit logged but trace outcome staysok and user has no result.
test_gap: Add glamour adapter test with safeEdit resolvingfalse and assert failure telemetry and usable fallback/retry policy. glamour.test.ts:16 mocks safeEdit=true; :147 asserts generated payload, without a false delivery case.
fix: Check safeEdit boolean and mark delivery failure; select bounded retry or short fallback. Consider a shared delivery helper to prevent repetition across adapters.
overlap: Security G37 explicit non-security handoff. Separate from package-owned oversize embed tail: distinct fix/deploy unit.
